title: Dependence
description: An observation that is not independent of an earlier one. One line of dependences.jsonl. This is what lets the fusion model count 100 copies as one source.

origin_obs_id.description: The earlier observation it depends on. Must be published before obs_id.

type.description: verbatim_copy: same text. rewrite: same claims, reworded. repost: platform share/forward. cites: explicitly attributes to the origin ('according to ...'). same_media: reuses the origin's image or video.
